_about: spruce: an 80.4s aura-gradient launch film for an AI app builder, derived frame-by-frame from an 80.4s launch film (1920x1080 @30fps). Authored in 1920x1080 reference px on the 1280x720 stage, rendered at device scale 1.5: render.mjs --fps 30 --scale 1.5. Placeholder product: Spruce (spruce.example), an AI app builder whose users make a yoga-studio booking app, a coffee site, a finance dashboard and an HR insights app. Grain-heavy aura grounds (cream rim, arc, dark, mark-shaped) carry word-by-word claims that re-centre as they grow; the product appears at punch-in scale, pressed by a white hand cursor.
_sections: S1 0-8.8 bubbles, the claim, typed line + braces, Meet, lockup | S2 8.8-23 orbs, big word, counter, bloom into a wall of sites, laptop | S3 23-33 glowing prompt pill into the app window, follow-up prompt close-up, tilted result | S4 33-41 collaboration: cursors, Invite, dialog, avatars, shared dashboard | S5 41-53.6 visual edits: target, toolbar, Edit Text panel, palette | S6 53.6-63 publish: big words, Publish, domain dialog, browser, laptop | S7 63-72.2 code view toggle, code window, claims | S8 72.2-80.4 mark-shaped aura, end card
_slots: Every spruce-window scene takes src (an .mp4 of YOUR app, ~1.54:1) + clip and keeps its glow, tilt and zoom keys. spruce-laptop takes image (a product photo replaces the drawn set) or images for its screen; spruce-wall takes images per site kind; spruce-avatars takes images avatar-1..5. Copy roles are tagged per scene; prompts are user-voice, names/emails/domains product-voice.
